# San Francisco Film School

> > San Francisco Film School (SFFS) offers accredited digital filmmaking programs including AAS Degrees, professional certificates, and hands-on bootcamps in the San Francisco Bay Area.

SFFS provides comprehensive film education through on-campus and online programs, featuring hands-on training in scriptwriting, cinematography, AI filmmaking, and more. The school offers veterans benefits, semester abroad programs in Italy, and prepares students for careers in the film industry with connections to festivals like Sundance and Cannes.

## Key Topics

- AAS Degree in Digital Filmmaking

## Degree and Certificate Programs

- [SFFS: Filmmaking School](https://film.sanfranciscofilmschool.edu/filmmaking-school): Main filmmaking school page featuring AAS Degree programs at SFFS
- [SFFS: Start Your Film Career](https://film.sanfranciscofilmschool.edu/start-your-film-career-1): Career-focused filmmaking programs including AAS Degree and certificates

## Bootcamps and Workshops

- [SFFS: Future Filmmaker Bootcamp](https://film.sanfranciscofilmschool.edu/short-film-bootcamp): Hands-on Future of Filmmaking Bootcamp for aspiring filmmakers in SF
- [SFFS: Fall 2024 Film Acting Bootcamp](https://film.sanfranciscofilmschool.edu/fall-2024-film-acting-bootcamp): Fall 2024 film acting bootcamp with Heida Reed using Meisner Technique
